Find the disjoint union of the sets A1={−2,−1,0} and A2={0,1,2}.

a

b
{(−2,2),(0,0),(1,1)}
c

{−2,−1,1,2}
e
{(−2,1),(−1,1),(0,1),(0,2),(1,2),(2,2)}
